authoritativeUpdater: custom signed-manifest updater (apps/desktop/src/updater/ + services/update/update-server.ts). No electron-updater/autoUpdater/setFeedURL anywhere in apps/desktop (grep PASS); no latest.yml/latest-mac.yml/latest-linux.yml generation — the signed UpdateManifest + /updates/* endpoints are the single update-metadata surface. No duplicate update system kept.
noPushToMainPublish: PASS: update-release.yml triggers are push-tags v*.*.* + workflow_dispatch only; desktop-release.yml is workflow_dispatch only. No `push: branches: [main]` production-publish trigger exists in either workflow.
ownerGate: intentional release only: version tag vX.Y.Z or manual workflow_dispatch with version+channel+rollout inputs; publish-manifest/canary jobs run under per-channel GitHub environments (approval-capable)
partialRelease: fail-fast build matrix (fail-fast: true); sign/sbom/publish stages stop on any failure; publish staged -> atomic manifest-last via publish-distribution.mjs
step: Verify tag/package version consistency (validate job, after version resolution)
stopsRelease: exit 1 on mismatch — manifest/build/publish never run
what: compares resolved release version against root package.json version AND apps/desktop/package.json version
